## Important

DcDNS does **not** accept pull requests that modify source code.

### Allowed
- Documentation suggestions
- Typos / README improvements discussed via Issues

### Not accepted
- Code changes to `DcDNS.py` or other source files
- Feature implementations via PR
- Forked / modified versions for redistribution

If you found a bug or have an idea, please open an **Issue** instead of a Pull Request.

## Checklist
- [ ] I read the license and CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] This PR does not modify protected source code
- [ ] I understand modified versions may not be distributed
